decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:

Site Location Plan; AP100; AP101; AP102; AP103; AP104; AP105; AP106; AP107; AP108; AP109; BP100; BP101; BP102; BP103; BP104; BP105; BP106; BP107; BP108; BP109; BP110; BP111; BP112; Space Versatility Catalogue; Cover Letter (PMV Planning, 19 January 2026); Supporting information (Email - Sophie Rae, 20 December 2025); 41 Whitfield Street Management Plan (Creative space and hotel) v3. 

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - The hireable cultural and creative space hereby permitted shall not be in operation outside the following times:

09:00 to 22:30 on Mondays to Fridays
09:00 to 23:00 on Saturdays
11:00 to 22:00 on Sundays and Bank Holidays. 

Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and the area generally in accordance with the requirements of policies G1, A1, A4 and TC4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017. 
Condition : 4 - No music shall be played on the premises in such a way as to be audible within any adjoining premises or on the adjoining highway.  

Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and the area generally in accordance with the requirements of policies G1, A1, A4 and TC4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017. 
Condition : 5 - The uses hereby permitted shall operate thereafter in accordance with the approved operational management plan entilted '41 Whitfield Street Mangement Plan (Creative space and hotel)'. 

Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and the area generally in accordance with the requirements of policies G1, A1, A4 and TC4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
description: Complete rehabilitation of the architectural and structural elements in the building, including new additional decorative components in the main elevation to assist the new museum shop, tea shop and theme accommodation.
